note: Official and established accounts only: disaster agencies, police, militaries, ministries and news desks. Never private individuals. Handles are unverified until the first run, which records whether each one worked. 'cc': '*' means a regional or global account whose posts are assigned to an area only when they name the country.
telegram_note: Read through each channel's public web preview (t.me/s/<channel>); no login. Channels were found by web search on 2026-09-26 and are unverified until the first run.
youtube_note: Each channel's public feed (youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=...), which needs no account or key. A channel is given by its @handle; the job looks up its channel id on the channel page. Titles, dates, thumbnails and links only: no downloading, transcripts or YouTube Data API. News desks and official channels only. Each channel below was checked on 2026-09-26 (the handle resolved to the right channel and its feed returned recent videos); handles that did not resolve were removed. Channels added on 2026-09-27 for the remaining areas were found by searching YouTube's public channel search for each area's national broadcaster, public or state broadcaster, main news desks and government agencies (tools/probe_youtube.mjs); each was kept only if its owner matched and it had uploaded within the last 31 days. 'kind' says whose voice it is: state media (government-run or -controlled), public broadcaster (publicly funded, editorially independent by charter), state-funded (US/UK) for foreign-government-funded services such as VOA, RFA, RFE/RL and BBC language services, government for a government's own channel, news desk for private outlets.
